snippet.title: Box or Void Demo Out Now!
snippet.description: Box or Void is a puzzle game about reversing positive and negative space. The obstacles in one space become pathways for the other. Move the characters and push boxes to change the layout of the levels. Master this duality and explore worlds with new mechanics that build on this core idea.
